title: [Lean] Execute binary comparison and difference-to-unary control
body:
## Coverage

Explicit author-checked context: upstream main 0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea; kappa = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. These generic routines do not establish or change the selected exponent.

Four checked modules execute binary-to-unary conversion, derive order from the seven-gate adder carry, branch into the opposite subtraction pass on underflow, physically extract the absolute difference, and charge the handoff to unary control production. They retain both source operand tracks and the direction flag, return the specified heads and count all three tapes.

Finite coverage: arbitrary finite equal-width paired Boolean words, including width zero and leading zeros. No unit-cost Nat subtraction, comparison or unbounded integer decoding is executed.

For paired width w and derived numeric difference d, the joined routine takes at most d*(2w+6)+30w+37 transitions and at most 2w+d+6 represented cells at every prefix. Binary-to-unary alone has exact first halt d*(2w+6)+2w+8. Difference/extraction takes exactly 17w+22 or 28w+28 according to the actual carry branch.

Important: costs depend on numeric magnitude d. Emitting d unary cells can take exponential time and space in the binary input width. This is not a linear-in-bitlength or whole-multiplier cost result.

Conditional-interface coverage: marked paired input encoding/equal width and initially blank binary/unary work tapes are supplied. The work counter is consumed to zeros; old scratch/output contents are not restored. Physical allocation, slot access and downstream branch-selected padding remain explicit.

Full-theorem coverage: no selected artifact success, physical Cell encoding, dirty-state restoration, recursive volume accounting or all-size multiplication/runtime theorem follows. The accepted unequal-width layout successor is deliberately outside this frozen chunk.

## Evidence and reproduction

Four unchanged new sources total 69,475 bytes. Their 34 complete standard-only axiom probes and seven full printed types passed local kernel checks and independent source/terminal review. The only accepted diagnostic is PairedDifferenceUnary's unnecessarySeqFocus style warning and its note; no sorryAx is accepted.

Five public prerequisites are reused without copying: PR1840 at 3f1b0641d5866f9d0b6cdd8e46db416fed6c5645, PR1869 at 65ab016b4a464e3f5e2dd26c1bb0ae477e1ebce8, and PR1899 at 6282571be5a5654cfb82568d8d70987bc4596add. Their exact source URLs and hashes were read back. REPRODUCE.md pins Lean 4.21.0 and Mathlib 308445d7985027f538e281e18df29ca16ede2ba3 and gives prospective fresh-scratch serial commands. No extra local CI preflight or relocated replay was run for publication.

## Overlap and attribution

The bounded comparison credits existing XOR, marked traversal, seven-gate addition, padding and counter/copy work. The new composition supplies actual carry-selected two-operand difference, paid magnitude extraction, unary emission and charged handoff. No global novelty or optimality claim is made. Public overlap details accompany the exact-source acceptance summary.

James Chang with OpenAI assistance; Apache-2.0. Existing Lean/Mathlib and prerequisite attribution is retained.
